mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sv_enterprise_document (kb_id, filename, normalized_name, status, object_key, size, error_message) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{filename}, #{normalizedName}, #{status}, #{objectKey}, #{size}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sv_enterprise_document WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

UPDATE sv_enterprise_document SET cleanup_attempt = #{newAttempt}, error_message = '' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELETING'
